integrated_show_outline.note: 候选窗口由整合稿集中维护；不是听感已确认的曲式高潮，也不写入正式启用的 windows 数组。

evidence_scope: score and offline stem signal analysis; no direct auditory appraisal or final instrument-role judgement

timing.note: Current renders contain the next-loop entry and 100 ms excess. Musical cycle is 256 seconds. Empty note cells may sustain sound. Poll timing offset is an observation granularity, not a required shift for every audible onset.

visual_time_scales.role: 细节流动/逐音符提示，避免主场景按每行切换

meter_status: 0.32/0.64 s are proposed visual subdivisions; do not label 80 ms as one musical beat or 2.56 s as a confirmed bar.

routing_example.visual: Normal musical-material handoffs stay within the frontal field; larger spatial handoffs are reserved for selected climaxes.

sections.title: 接入与生成
sections.visual: 从电脑、手机屏幕与明确的浏览器窗口承载点阵、个人站和早期 VR 图像开始；前方音乐逐层建立，后续再逐步展开载体与空间。

sections.title: 创造与传播的繁荣
sections.evidence: 12—39 序列段建立持续节奏与低音型，51.20/71.68/81.92 秒变换素材组合
sections.visual: 早段撤去全局容器后，以长段无界内容场展开制作、传播与公共生活，旧内容保留年代样式。

sections.title: 入口与秩序改变
sections.evidence: 102.40 秒 pattern 22/乐器6由通道4交到通道2；通道4在部分段落实际安静
sections.visual: 保持无界外部，以局部入口和维护条件改变内容的可用关系。

sections.title: 过载与失去选择
sections.evidence: 52—59 段为可重复的密集四通道组合；163.84/168.96 秒再次换型，不能据空pattern断言全曲安静
sections.visual: 无界空间中重复、副本、请求与局部遮挡增殖，保留原有音乐组织。

sections.title: 抽离与留存
sections.evidence: 186.88 秒通道1 pattern0且分轨实际静音，194.56 秒重新加入过门；其他声部仍有延续
sections.visual: 撤去人声/环境/辅助冲击层和大部分近景，让原曲继续在；远处只亮一份保存下来的作品或入口。

sections.title: 再兴与共同创造
sections.evidence: 197.12 秒通道1转为多乐器 pattern11，并重现较早的声部配置；235.52 秒 pattern22/乐器6交到通道1
sections.visual: 无界中先建立回应，215.04—235.52 秒为内外/远近重构的视觉候选；235.52 秒交接仍在前方小范围发生，不新增分轨高潮。

sections.title: 继续：一起做下去
sections.evidence: 96—99 段撤去部分新触发后接循环准备；256 秒回到开头，不是天然终止式
sections.visual: 人尺度接手与创作继续，外围保持无界，音乐收束方式仍待试听。

visual_curves.units: 0..1; relative design weights, not physical photometry

signal_method.rms: mean-centered per window/channel before RMS; not LUFS or emotion
signal_method.why: Temporary renders have DC offsets and sustained voices, so raw RMS/note counts alone misrepresent activity.

open_choices: Actual musical meter and timbral-role audition
Exact trajectories, viewing zone and limited gain automation after headset prototype
Exact short climax windows and expanded voices after audition; normal frontal cohesion is already chosen.

spatial_audio.user_intent: 分轨空间音频，但大部分时间四条声部在前方轻微可辨、整体融合；仅高潮短暂明显分拆。
spatial_audio.arrangement_editing: user-selected: spatial changes primary, limited dynamics; preserve original notes, tempo, arrangement and source timbre
spatial_audio.recommended_start: User refined: cohesive frontal four-voice stage for normal passages; reserve obvious separation for selected short climaxes, with limited dynamics.
spatial_audio.coordinate_frame: World / stage forward defines the frontal music field; it does not rotate with the listener headset.

source_preparation.current_format: 4 stereo WAV stems with mostly fixed legacy left/right gain, not four independent binaural renders
source_preparation.target: 4 mono sources, matching start and sample length, common gain reference; remove legacy pan and address DC offsets
source_preparation.normalization: Preserve musical relative levels; do not independently peak-normalize each voice.

processing_levels.space: Four voices subtly layered in front in normal passages; obvious separation reserved for selected climaxes.
processing_levels.balance: reference levels with controlled spatial attenuation

processing_levels.notes_tempo_and_triggers: preserve initially; larger structural edits separately decide
processing_levels.source_timbre: may include explicit filters / wet processing / auxiliary layers
processing_levels.space: Four voices subtly layered in front in normal passages; obvious separation reserved for selected climaxes.
processing_levels.balance: authored section fades, voice reduction and restoration

scene_staging.space: voices enter in the front field and form a cohesive piece
subtle frontal calls; rare selected climax expansion only
mostly frontal cohesion; spatial spread/convergence becomes obvious only at selected pressure climaxes
near activity withdraws; continuing music retreats as a cohesive frontal group
front response and layers recover; later expansion only if a climax is explicitly chosen
settle into frontal cohesion; ending / loop authored explicitly

implementation_constraints: VRC_SpatialAudioSource spatialization properties initialize once; documentation does not support changing them through runtime animation. Do not promise animated volumetric radius.
Volumetric radius is not a default listener-enclosing surround technique; use carefully for distant large sources and verify transitions / interference.
Turn off music-source Doppler initially so moving sources preserve pitch.
Match visuals and actual listener/source positions during teleportation and RenderTexture view substitution.
Keep four voices aligned locally on one music timebase; network synchronizes overall timeline, not individual notes.
Unity PlayScheduled has DSP scheduling, but Udon availability remains unverified in this project.
Calibrate world source gain explicitly; avatar-specific limits/compression are not world-source limits.
Validate headphones/headset, multiple listening positions, movement, late joining, isolation and restoration.
Normal staging is frontal and cohesive; do not carry forward the superseded rear four-corner default.

sources.scope: world spatialization, falloff, source radius, initialized properties and world/avatar distinctions
Unity DSP scheduling capability; not proof of Udon exposure

selected_mode.label: 空间变化为主，少量动态处理
primary_controls: rare authored climax expansion and return

refinement.normal: Four distinguishable but subtly separated voices in front; preserve musical cohesion.
refinement.climax: Only selected climaxes widen / lift / separate a small number of suitable voices, then return to frontal cohesion.
refinement.sound_effects: This restriction concerns main music; environmental and action sounds may still occupy the surrounding scene.

prototype_staging.origin: nominal listener ear height at center of viewing zone
prototype_staging.frame: world / stage fixed; does not rotate with headset yaw
prototype_staging.scope: Normal-passage frontal fusion/localization audition only. Coordinates and roughly 30-degree total width are authored candidates, not user-confirmed exact values.
prototype_staging.extra_gain_scope: additional fader automation only, not a cap on authored distance attenuation; exact amounts unconfirmed
prototype_staging.stable_reference: The frontal music field is the normal reference; all four voices remain mostly cohesive.
constraints: one audible direct voice per source material during ordinary handoffs
match sound positions to visible objects
headset and multiple listener positions must be validated

climax_expansion.trigger: manually selected short musical/narrative climax windows, not instantaneous RMS
climax_expansion.motion: expand, hold briefly, return to normal frontal positions
climax_expansion.anchors: keep suitable rhythmic/low support in front; channel assignments depend on the passage
climax_expansion.default_outside_windows: frontal subtle separation; no wide/rear orbiting

prototype_staging.supersedes: Previous front/rear four-corner default audition layout.

world_motion_reference.main_music: 演出前方参照独立于景物运动组，不逐头部跟随。
world_motion_reference.scene_audio: 跟随发声物变换后位置，作用范围与音量另外校准。
world_motion_reference.arrangement_and_clock: 保持原四轨编配与同一时基，不新增或自动启用高潮。
